verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API exposes payroll, contractor payment, and reporting endpoints (GET payrolls, payroll.paid webhooks, contractor payment groups) that an agent could pull via API, and an MCP dev-assistant server exists to let AI tools interact with the API/docs, which supports agent-driven data retrieval. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated payroll journal/GL export feature or reconciliation-ready ledger format, and no evidence of accounting-system sync beyond generic 'we integrate with accounting apps' mention. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal entry/GL export endpoint or format, documented reconciliation workflow into a ledger, evidence of agent-specific automated reconciliation use case.
